rcid.description: Recent change ID. Only present if requested with the ids prop.

type.description: Kind of change: edit, new, log, categorize or external.

ns.description: Namespace of the page. Only present if requested with the title prop.

title.description: Prefixed title of the page. Only present if requested with the title prop.

pageid.description: Page ID. Only present if requested with the ids prop.

revid.description: Revision ID, 0 for a change that is not an edit. Only present if requested with the ids prop.

old_revid.description: Revision ID of the previous revision, 0 if there is none. Only present if requested with the ids prop.

user.description: Name of the user who made the change. Only present if requested with the user prop.

userid.description: ID of the user who made the change, 0 for an anonymous user. Only present if requested with the userid prop.

anon.description: Present, and true, if the user is anonymous.

temp.description: Present, and true, if the user is a temporary account.

bot.description: Whether the change was made by a bot. Only present if requested with the flags prop.

new.description: Whether the change created a page. Only present if requested with the flags prop.

minor.description: Whether the change is a minor edit. Only present if requested with the flags prop.

oldlen.description: Size of the page before the change, in bytes. Only present if requested with the sizes prop.

newlen.description: Size of the page after the change, in bytes. Only present if requested with the sizes prop.

timestamp.description: Time of the change, in ISO 8601 format. Only present if requested with the timestamp prop.

comment.description: Edit summary or log comment. Only present if requested with the comment prop.

parsedcomment.description: Edit summary or log comment, as HTML. Only present if requested with the parsedcomment prop.

redirect.description: Whether the page is a redirect. Only present if requested with the redirect prop.

patrolled.description: Whether the change is patrolled. Only present if requested with the patrolled prop.

unpatrolled.description: Whether the change is unpatrolled and the user may patrol it. Only present if requested with the patrolled prop.

autopatrolled.description: Whether the change was patrolled automatically. Only present if requested with the patrolled prop.

logid.description: ID of the log entry, for a log change. Only present if requested with the loginfo prop.

logtype.description: Type of the log entry, for a log change. Only present if requested with the loginfo prop.

logaction.description: Action of the log entry, for a log change. Only present if requested with the loginfo prop.

logparams.description: Parameters of the log entry, as formatted by the log type, for a log change. Only present if requested with the loginfo prop.

tags.description: Tags of the change. Only present if requested with the tags prop.

sha1.description: SHA-1 hash of the content of the revision. Only present if requested with the sha1 prop.

actionhidden.description: Present, and true, if the log action is hidden.

userhidden.description: Present, and true, if the user is hidden.

commenthidden.description: Present, and true, if the comment is hidden.

sha1hidden.description: Present, and true, if the content hash is hidden.

suppressed.description: Present, and true, if hidden parts of the change are suppressed.
